at-rule-disallowed-list.message: No animation: intermediate pixel states leave ghosting the waveform cannot clear (AGENTS.md hard rule 3).

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Motion and compositing effects are forbidden on e-paper (AGENTS.md hard rule 3). `none`/`auto` — the resets in base.css — are the only accepted values.

selector-disallowed-list.message: No :hover: a capacitive panel reports contact, not proximity — use :focus-visible, [aria-selected], [aria-checked] or [data-active] (AGENTS.md hard rule 4).
